description.value: A historic inn operating since 1896 on the shores of Heriot Bay, Quadra Island, offering European-style hotel rooms, ocean-view cabins with full kitchens, a two-storey suite, an RV park and campground, and a full-service marina. The on-site HBI Pub and Herons Dining Room make it the social hub of Quadra Island, with live music, events, and west coast cuisine. Quadra Island is a short ferry hop from Campbell River and is noted for mountain biking, kayaking, and whale-watching.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully active, showing 2026 cabin and suite rates, confirming the business is open.
